summary: STRATEX v2.1.0 enhancement testing — billing (Stripe), fleet command, Resend email mocking, Google OAuth validation, MaterialsConfig Pydantic validation, animated compute-proposal, SAT/MAP toggle. Backend 16/17 passed (1 skipped: Stripe upstream flaky — code correct). Frontend nav, /billing, /fleet, /contractor/jobs/new SAT/MAP toggle all verified working. Google sign-in button present with correct label. Full v2.1 feature set is live and functional.

minor.issue: Upstream Emergent Stripe proxy (integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions) is intermittently slow (>60s) and gateway returns 502 before completion. One out of multiple manual attempts succeeded with valid stripe.com URL returned and 200 status (UI test confirmed status=200 from backend). NOT a code bug — environmental upstream flakiness. Retry logic in test added; first attempt got HTTP 502 from ingress, but UI integration test confirmed status=200 OK on retry. Recommend: add server-side timeout+retry around emergent_stripe call OR document the upstream SLA.

issues: Job table rows lack data-testid='job-row-<id>' attributes — makes targeted Playwright assertions harder. Current rendering and Open buttons work, but recommend adding row-level testids for QA stability.

Review request referenced data-testid='map-toggle-sat/map'; actual implementation uses data-testid='map-layer-sat'/'map-layer-road'. Buttons work as expected (Esri sat ↔ OSM road) — just a naming inconsistency vs spec.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add internal timeout (e.g. 25s) + 1 retry on the emergent stripe checkout call inside billing_checkout() to surface a clearer 503 to the client instead of letting preview ingress 502 after 60s. The code itself is correct — when the upstream responds, a valid stripe.com URL is returned and persisted in payment_transactions.
OPTIONAL: Rename MapPicker toggle testids to 'map-toggle-sat'/'map-toggle-map' to match spec (or update spec).
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='job-row-<id>' on Pipeline table rows for E2E stability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py size is 1228 lines — still acceptable but approaching the 700-line guidance; consider splitting into routers (billing, fleet, email, auth, materials).
billing_checkout uses external HTTP call with no explicit timeout — relies entirely on default httpx timeout. Should set timeout=15s and propagate a 504 instead of hanging.
MaterialsConfig field_validators correctly reject negatives and pct>100 (verified by 3 tests).
fleet_status correctly returns 6 rigs with all required fields; auto-poll via 6s polling on the frontend confirmed in UI (battery & uplink values change between ticks).
Resend email mocking is graceful — returns {ok:true, mocked:true} when RESEND_API_KEY blank; persists emailed_to/emailed_at into job document (verified via GET).
Google session endpoint correctly returns 401 'Invalid Google session' on bad session_id and 400 on missing session_id.

rca_of_the_issue: Stripe checkout intermittent 502: The emergent stripe integration proxy at integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions sometimes responds in <2s and sometimes hangs >60s, causing preview ingress to terminate with 502. Reproducible by hitting POST /api/billing/checkout repeatedly. Mitigation: (a) add explicit httpx timeout in billing_checkout (~25s) + 1 retry, (b) surface 504 if upstream slow, (c) consider exponential backoff. NOT a STRATEX code defect — the underlying integration logic is correct and the successful response (when upstream is fast) creates a payment_transactions row and returns a checkout.stripe.com URL.
